name: Harneloop
summary: Helps an AI agent learn from what went wrong: inspect real results, trace the mistake and keep only harness changes a test supports.

distribution.label: Install from PyPI
distribution.scope: The harneloop command-line tool as a Python package. The repository also holds docs, examples, tests and translations that are not needed to use it.

installation.title: Install the command
installation.body: Install it as an isolated tool with uv, then run the doctor check. You can also use python -m pip install harneloop in your own Python 3.11+ environment.
installation.label: Harneloop on PyPI
installation.command:
uv tool install harneloop
harneloop doctor

installation.title: Give your agent the repository
installation.body: Harneloop is meant to be driven by an agent with file and terminal access. Ask it to read the README and docs/agent-onboarding.md, then use Harneloop to create a harness unit for the task you want it to get better at.
installation.label: Agent quick start prompt

installation.title: Or start it yourself
installation.body: harneloop setup opens a guided menu that creates and registers a harness unit. After that you can check any unit by name from any folder.

manual_setup: Python 3.11 or newer and git. uv is recommended for an isolated install; if uv says its tool folder is not on PATH, run uv tool update-shell and open a new terminal.
You bring the task and the environment it runs in. Harneloop does not discover endpoints, tools, screenshots or output paths for you; the agent maps them into the harness unit.
notes: Public alpha. The core loop works; the first published case study is Blender scene construction with ViperMesh.
It changes the harness around the model (instructions, tools, context and checks), not the model itself. A proposed change becomes the working version only after a test supports it.
